html:
Whether you are landing at Chennai International Airport, heading to business meetings on OMR, planning a family temple visit, or organizing an outstation weekend getaway, choosing the right car rental in Chennai makes every mile stress-free. At SR Tours & Travels, we have been serving South Chennai and the greater Chennai metro area with clean, well-maintained AC vehicles, punctual chauffeurs, and 100% transparent pricing.

1. Why Book Chauffeur-Driven Car Rental in Chennai with SR Tours?

  • Clean, Sanitised AC Fleet: Every vehicle is inspected before pickup for AC cooling, tyre safety, and spotless interiors.
  • No Hidden Charges: Clear upfront rates for local hourly packages and outstation per-kilometer billing.
  • 24/7 Doorstep Pickup Across Chennai: Fast dispatch from our office in Mylai Balaji Nagar, Pallikaranai & Madipakkam to Chrompet, Tambaram, Medavakkam, Velachery, Nanganallur, Pallavaram, Perungalathur, Vandalur, and Chennai Airport.
  • Experienced Highway & Hill Drivers: Polite, verified drivers who know Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Kerala routes inside out.

3. Types of Car Rental Services Available in Chennai

Local Hourly Car Rentals

Perfect for shopping in T. Nagar, hospital appointments, wedding errands, or corporate visits across Guindy, Velachery, and OMR. Choose 4 Hours / 40 Km or 8 Hours / 80 Km packages.

Chennai Airport Pickup & Drop (24/7)

Skip surge pricing and cancellations. Our drivers track your flight and wait at Chennai Airport (MAA) for smooth transfers to any locality in Chennai or nearby highways.

Outstation Car Rentals from Chennai

Book comfortable one-day or multi-day cabs to Tirupati, Mahabalipuram, Pondicherry, Rameswaram, Ooty, Kodaikanal, and Munnar.

4. Frequently Asked Questions – Car Rental in Chennai

How do I book a car rental in Chennai with SR Tours?

Call or WhatsApp +91 9884300373 / 9884050506 or submit your trip details on our Contact page for instant confirmation.

Are toll, parking, and interstate permit charges included?

Toll, parking, and state permit charges are billed at actuals with receipts, keeping your fare 100% transparent.

Do you provide car rentals in Madipakkam, Pallikaranai, and Tambaram?

Yes! Our main office is at No. 1389, Mylai Balaji Nagar, 3rd Block, 1st Main Road, Madipakkam, Pallikaranai, Chennai - 600100, offering quick 15–20 minute pickups across South Chennai.
